title: Nine Squares of Sharing
subtitle: 巧克力与甜食 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 巧克力与甜食（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：巧克力与甜食（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：chocolate　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chocolate 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my mother was sent to share ① chocolate she could not keep, and she said the sharing was the whole of the lesson. The ② chocolate, meaning the bar and not the cocoa, was nine squares long and was shared by whoever came last; chocolate, she said, is the only thing in a pocket that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chocolate in that pocket had the same wrapper, and the ④ chocolate at the end, meaning the one the shopkeeper kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever shared properly. Chocolate, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chocolate was the whole of the visit, meaning the comfort it carried and not the bar. The ⑥ chocolate, meaning the comfort and not any of that, is the only thing in a visit that everybody accepts and nobody questions; chocolate, he said, is either something you share or the only word that means both a bar and a comfort. She said the comfort is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ chocolate had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the wrapper. The ⑧ chocolate of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine squares and eleven years of sharing; chocolate, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chocolate I remember is the one at the end, which was shared in 1977 and is still described as the sweetest in the county. A ⑩ chocolate, my grandmother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being shared; every chocolate, she said, is a comfort that has agreed to look like a bar. She said the comfort was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 巧克力（指那块巧克力本身，与那些可可相对）
C. 固定搭配：share a chocolate 分一块巧克力
D. n. 巧克力（指口袋里每一块）
E. n. 巧克力（指末尾那一块）
F. n. 慰藉（抽象：它承载的那份安慰）
G. n. 那份安慰（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chocolate, meaning the bar and not the cocoa
chocolate was the whole of the visit
the chocolate had become a number in a report
The chocolate of the whole thing
A chocolate, my grandmother said in 1982

answers.why: share a chocolate 意为“分一块巧克力”，1957 年母亲被派去分她留不住的那块巧克力。
chocolate 意为“巧克力”，指那块巧克力本身而不是那些可可，共九小块，由最后来的人分。
chocolate 指口袋里每一块巧克力，每一块都是同样的包装纸。
chocolate 指末尾那一块（店主留下的那一块），是唯一有人认真分过的。
chocolate 意为“慰藉”，抽象指它承载的那份安慰，父亲说 chocolate 就是那次探望的全部。
chocolate 为抽象用法，指那份安慰本身，是一次探望里人人都接受、却没人质疑的东西。
chocolate 意为“巧克力”，到 1972 年这块 chocolate 成了报告里的一个数字。
chocolate 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九小块和十一年的分享。
chocolate 意为“巧克力”，我记得的是末尾那一块，1977 年分过，至今仍被说成全县最甜的。
chocolate 为抽象总称，祖母说一块巧克力是唯一会因为被认真分享而变好的东西。
